resources.string: Light up each word as it is spoken. Requires a publisher transcript that carries per-word timings (JSON transcripts usually do). This build has no on-device recognition, so episodes without a transcript cannot use it.

· Discover: browse daily charts by region and category
· Search: find shows or episodes by keyword, or paste an RSS URL
· Share shows: create an image with the show artwork, title and Reverb branding
· Radio: roam at random or follow time-of-day moods
· Library: subscriptions, latest, favorites, downloads and history
· Offline: download episodes, optionally Wi-Fi only
· Playback: speed, skip, sleep timer, resume, background and lock screen controls
· Transcript: for episodes whose publisher provides one, read along in the player
· Show notes: swipe on the player page
· Update reminders: get notified when a new episode lands
· Appearance: dark/light/system, text size, accent colour, multiple languages
